about: What this certificate does and does not assert. It binds the shipped evidence by hash and states which checks pass and which do NOT. It is deliberately not a claim of algorithmic success: the success premise fails and is recorded as failing.

assert_notes.claim_is_ceiling: 128.9437 is the 4-dp ceiling of 128.9436093073, so the at-most direction holds.
assert_notes.control_reproduces_v10n_bit_for_bit: 200 trials dp4: 6 successes, 10148289 records, 6 meets, 1 self, 8 ring hits, identical to the v10n binary.
assert_notes.escape_changes_state: carried from v10n: integrated path test, unchanged in this version.
assert_notes.ring_depth_4_verified: carried from v10n: self-test rows in the shipped object, unchanged in this version.
assert_notes.ring_escape_exactly_inert: P1 (guard, no ring) and P2 (guard, ring, escape) return identical success counts in all four DP cells (100/22/9/4) at 3000 trials.
assert_notes.success_ge_floor: FALSE, and it is the reason this package is not promotable. p per instance <= 2^-61.55 (w=2 2^-60.55) against a 0.39 floor. The previous certificate carried success_ge_floor=true while its own claim text said the floor was not met; that contradiction is corrected here.
